displayName: 天选之子 The Chosen One
description: Unofficial The Chosen One fan-art companion from Animator vs. Animation. Original gentle desktop choreography includes lifting a blank window-shaped panel, drawing and stepping through a harmless light ring, tidying small paper squares, a bent-knee leap and articulated three-direction runs. The black stick figure keeps a hollow head with no invented facial features. No destructive fire, attacks or damage. Not official or endorsed.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
